request.system_prompt: Return exactly one JSON object. Convert the grounded mining-controller candidate into the Signal spec object only: a new signal_id in lowercase snake_case ([a-z0-9_] only; the runtime normalizes it), a definition faithful to the measurement, a retrieval policy whose source_types cover the cited evidence source types (family names like news, filing, or transcript are interchangeable with concrete types like company_news, sec_filing, earnings_call) and coverage minima that do not exceed what the cited evidence demonstrates. Preserve the controller modality: a structured measurement must name a registered deterministic function that exactly matches it (if none matches, report the capability gap instead of recasting it as LLM); a narrative predicate must declare the LLM skill modality. Return exactly {"spec": {...}}.

predicate.semantic_condition: A point-in-time company news, filing, or earnings-transcript document discloses a confirmed order, award, or contract for the company's products or services.

falsifiers.condition: No point-in-time narrative document in the lookback window discloses a confirmed order, award, or contract.
The narrative disclosure is only a proposal, letter of intent, or non-binding discussion rather than a confirmed order.

modality.structured: A typed point-in-time measurement whose value is fully determined by inputs and parameters; it requires an exact registered deterministic function.
modality.narrative: A semantic predicate over source text; it requires a grounded LLM skill.
modality.mixed: Split numeric measurement and narrative fallback into separate Signals.

value_semantics.positive: Evidence in the direction of the fixed surge target.
value_semantics.neutral: Available measurement without decisive directional evidence.
value_semantics.unavailable: Required point-in-time measurement inputs are insufficient.
value_semantics.orientation: Do not equate numeric sign with Signal direction. Derive a new candidate's orientation from the observed contrast and keep its definition, implementation and fixtures consistent. Report the underlying quantity in interpretation/evidence. Do not reverse an existing stable definition or copy case labels into the skill.

retrieval.execution_order: Coverage must resolve before the function or LLM skill runs.
retrieval.source_types: Use source types/formats supported by the supplied evidence; do not invent a provider category.
retrieval.minimum_observations: Counts the largest explicit structured series in a document: lists named prices, observations, rows or series, or lists of records with date/timestamp fields. A standalone financial fact is not such a series. Leave null unless this is a real input requirement.
retrieval.period_requirements: minimum_distinct_periods and minimum_period_span_days check period coverage, not concept completeness or comparable duration. The implementation must still check every required component and period.
retrieval.fixtures: Non-unavailable fixtures must satisfy the same retrieval coverage as production, with literal source evidence and point-in-time dates. Missing-input fixtures may expect unavailable; technical failures are not successful unavailable measurements. Every fixture's expected value must agree with the skill's own documented applicability boundaries: a lookalike the skill scores neutral must not be expected unavailable, and a documented non-applicable case must not be expected decisive.

constraints: fixture source_type must be declared by raw_retrieval

deterministic_function_contracts.financial.cash_burn_rate_elevated: Measure cash burn as absolute negative operating cash flow / cash for the latest SEC duration, using the closest same-currency cash instant at or before period end. Non-negative operating cash flow is a zero burn ratio. Missing, non-positive cash, mismatched, or stale facts yield unavailable. burn_threshold defaults to 0.10; qualifying burn is positive, observed zero burn is negative, and an observed below-threshold positive burn is neutral.
deterministic_function_contracts.financial.cash_reserves: Measure the latest SEC instant cash and equivalents balance, in its reported currency units, without normalizing by burn, revenue or company size. Missing or stale current cash facts yield unavailable. Numeric states use positive_min (default 0) and negative_max (default positive_min): value >= positive_min is positive, otherwise value <= negative_max is negative, otherwise neutral. Thresholds do not change the measurement. max_period_age_days (default 550) bounds current SEC period age; older comparative periods remain allowed.
deterministic_function_contracts.financial.cash_to_current_liabilities_ra: Measure latest cash and equivalents / current liabilities for the same SEC instant period and reported currency. Non-positive liabilities and missing, mismatched, or stale facts yield unavailable. Numeric states use positive_min (default 1) and negative_max (default positive_min).
deterministic_function_contracts.financial.gross_margin_change: Measure gross-margin change: latest GrossProfit / revenue minus the previous comparable-duration margin. GrossProfit and revenue must match start, end and units within each period. Missing matched periods, zero revenue or stale current facts yield unavailable. Numeric states use positive_min (default 0) and negative_max (default positive_min): value >= positive_min is positive, otherwise value <= negative_max is negative, otherwise neutral. Thresholds do not change the measurement. max_period_age_days (default 550) bounds current SEC period age; older comparative periods remain allowed.
deterministic_function_contracts.financial.liquidity_runway_months: Measure cash runway in months from the latest SEC operating cash flow duration and the closest same-currency cash instant at or before its end. Monthly burn is absolute cash flow divided by the rounded reported duration in months. Missing, non-positive, mismatched, or stale facts yield unavailable. Runway <= positive_runway_max_months (default 6) is positive, runway >= negative_runway_min_months (default 12) is negative, and values between are neutral. Non-negative operating cash flow is negative evidence of a low-runway condition (an effectively unbounded burn runway).
deterministic_function_contracts.financial.net_share_retirement_yoy: Measure net share retirement as 1 - current / prior-year weighted-average shares over comparable periods. Positive means net retirement and negative means dilution; this is not a cash buyback amount. Missing comparable or stale current facts yield unavailable. Numeric states use positive_min (default 0) and negative_max (default positive_min): value >= positive_min is positive, otherwise value <= negative_max is negative, otherwise neutral. Thresholds do not change the measurement. max_period_age_days (default 550) bounds current SEC period age; older comparative periods remain allowed.
deterministic_function_contracts.financial.operating_cash_flow_margin: Measure operating cash flow margin as operating cash flow / positive revenue for the latest matching SEC duration period (same start, end and units). Requires both revenue and operating-cash-flow facts. This does not measure operating-income alignment or cash runway. Missing/mismatched/stale facts yield unavailable. Numeric states use positive_min (default 0) and negative_max (default positive_min): value >= positive_min is positive, otherwise value <= negative_max is negative, otherwise neutral. Thresholds do not change the measurement. max_period_age_days (default 550) bounds current SEC period age; older comparative periods remain allowed.
deterministic_function_contracts.financial.revenue_acceleration: Measure revenue acceleration as latest year-over-year revenue growth minus an earlier comparable growth rate. Requires two supported revenue year-over-year pairs with matching units and nonzero denominators; incomplete/stale current facts yield unavailable. Numeric states use positive_min (default 0) and negative_max (default positive_min): value >= positive_min is positive, otherwise value <= negative_max is negative, otherwise neutral. Thresholds do not change the measurement. max_period_age_days (default 550) bounds current SEC period age; older comparative periods remain allowed.
deterministic_function_contracts.financial.revenue_growth_yoy: Measure revenue_growth_yoy as current / comparable prior-year revenue - 1. Requires SEC duration facts, matching units and comparable year-over-year periods; zero prior revenue or missing/stale current facts yields unavailable. Numeric states use positive_min (default 0) and negative_max (default positive_min): value >= positive_min is positive, otherwise value <= negative_max is negative, otherwise neutral. Thresholds do not change the measurement. max_period_age_days (default 550) bounds current SEC period age; older comparative periods remain allowed.
deterministic_function_contracts.market.max_drawdown_1y: Measure the minimum price / preceding running peak - 1 over all observations in the latest supplied metadata.prices series. This function does not itself restrict dates to one year; retrieval owns the point-in-time series window. Missing prices yield unavailable; invalid or nonpositive prices fail validation. Numeric states use positive_min (default 0) and negative_max (default positive_min): value >= positive_min is positive, otherwise value <= negative_max is negative, otherwise neutral. Thresholds do not change the measurement.
deterministic_function_contracts.market.price_momentum_126d: Measure last / first price - 1 over the final lookback_observations + 1 supplied metadata.prices values (default lookback_observations=126, positive integer). Fewer observations yield unavailable; prices must be finite positive numbers. Retrieval owns dates and adjustment convention. Numeric states use positive_min (default 0) and negative_max (default positive_min): value >= positive_min is positive, otherwise value <= negative_max is negative, otherwise neutral. Thresholds do not change the measurement.
deterministic_function_contracts.news.negative_word_count: Count case-insensitive literal substring occurrences across input documents. terms defaults to decline, loss, risk, delay, investigation, default. Count >= negative_count_min (default 1) is negative; otherwise neutral. This measures lexical frequency, not semantic sentiment or event severity.
